evidence.sequence: curated: GRCh38 primary assembly, A/C/G/T only (other letters are assembly gaps)
evidence.cpg_islands: curated: UCSC cpgIslandExt, fetched once per chromosome through the REST API
evidence.coding: curated: GENCODE v50 canonical CDS of protein-coding genes, with phase
evidence.motifs: predicted: JASPAR 2026 sites recorded by the motif runs (motifs_<chrom>)
evidence.tiers: inferred: budget tiers (budget_<chrom>) and UNKNOWN block classes (unknown_<chrom>)
evidence.code_length: measured: ideal code length, -log2 of the mixture's probability for each base

markov_note: in_sample is the empirical entropy with every parameter free: not a code, shown to say how far fitting a sequence on itself cheats; adaptive pays for its parameters as it learns; held_out is fitted on chr22

method.fitting: static models fitted on both strands of chr22; adaptive models fitted as they code; annotation costs charged; mixture window and temperature chosen from a grid and charged
method.duplication_partners: an earlier chromosome in karyotype order, or earlier on the same one
